statements.status_notes: kube-vip starts its gobgp server with ListenPort: -1, meaning it never accepts inbound BGP connections. Only explicitly configured peers can send UPDATE messages containing NEXT_HOP attributes. An arbitrary network adversary cannot reach the vulnerable code path without first compromising a configured BGP peer.
